consultasBanco.descricao: Medição aprovada: exatamente UMA conta a pagar real no Financeiro, com a obra (project_id) e centro de custo
consultasBanco.sql: SELECT m.status, m.total_amount, (SELECT count(*) FROM finance.financial_entries f WHERE f.idempotency_key = 'measurement.payable:' || m.id)::int AS contas, f.nature, f.entry_type, f.amount, f.status AS status_conta, f.construction_project_id = $2 AS da_obra, f.cost_center_id IS NOT NULL AS com_centro_de_custo FROM construction.stage_measurements m JOIN finance.financial_entries f ON f.id = m.payable_financial_entry_id WHERE m.id = $1
consultasBanco.invariante: PAYABLE, 1 conta, PAYABLE/DEBIT do mesmo valor, ligada à obra e com centro de custo
